title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.78.0
author: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: This PR unifies auth/retries semantics and improves streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. It also applies parity fixes to bring behavior in line across languages, adds E2E tests for the streaming surface, and bumps SDK package versions to v1.78.0. Motivation: Customers and internal services expect consistent SDK behavior for auth token refresh, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming cancellation/finalization. Divergence between language SDKs has caused subtle bugs and increased support burden. What changed: - Auth: centralize token refresh behavior and introduce a concise token provider interface. Default token refresh is now proactive (refresh before expiry window) with opt-out. - Retries: unified retry policy configuration across SDKs (max attempts, initial backoff, multiplier, jitter). Added idempotency guidance and sane defaults tuned for Redwood inference gateway. - Streaming: improved client-side streaming ergonomics: explicit cancel()/close() methods, consistent chunk framing across SDKs, and better error propagation on mid-stream failures. - Parity fixes: align JSON payload validation, function/tool-calling metadata, and structured-output helpers. - Tests & CI: new integration tests for streaming cancellation and retry semantics; flakiness mitigations added. - Docs & changelogs: per-SDK CHANGELOG.md updates and a consolidated docs/sdk-updates.md describing migration notes and new configuration knobs. Checklist: - [x] Python SDK: auth token provider, retry middleware, streaming helpers, tests - [x] TypeScript SDK: auth adapter, unified retry util, streaming API ergonomics, tests - [x] Go SDK: auth provider interface, retry client, streaming helpers, tests - [x] Integration tests added (CI e2e) - [x] Docs and CHANGELOGs updated - [x] Version bumps to v1.78.0 for all SDKs Backwards compatibility notes: Defaults changed to proactive token refresh and updated retry backoff parameters; both are configurable and backward-compatible by explicitly setting previous values. See docs/sdk-updates.md for migration steps. Release notes: See release_notes field below for the highlights.

release_notes: v1.78.0: Unified auth and retry semantics across SDKs; improved streaming ergonomics (cancel/close, consistent framing); parity fixes in structured output and function-calling metadata; new integration tests and minor CI flakiness mitigations. Defaults changed: proactive token refresh and updated retry backoff (multiplier=1.6). See docs/sdk-updates.md for migration steps.
notes: This PR consolidates several prior language-specific patches into a single coordinated release. Post-merge tasks: publish SDK packages to PyPI/NPM and push Go modules; notify SDK consumers of default retry/backoff change via release notes and community channels.
